mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_stock_movement (item_id, movement_type, qty, stock_after, request_id, request_line_id, operator_user_id, applicant_user_id, remark) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{movementType}, #{qty}, #{stockAfter}, #{requestId}, #{requestLineId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_stock_movement WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_stock_movement WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT m.id, m.item_id AS itemId, COALESCE(i.name, '未知物品') AS itemName, m.movement_type AS movementType, m.qty, m.stock_after AS stockAfter, m.request_id AS requestId, m.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, m.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, m.remark, m.created_at AS createdAt, r.applicant_name AS applicantName, r.applicant_group AS applicantGroup FROM material_stock_movement m LEFT JOIN material_item i ON m.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN material_request r ON m.request_id = r.id WHERE m.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_stock_movement WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
